children: Palo Alto Networks is acquiring Console, an AI-native platform designed to enable agentic capabilities across enterprise operations. The deal aims to strengthen the company's Cortex security platform by allowing users to build agentic workflows using natural language. Console's technology lets organizations apply AI-driven analysis and action to resolve alerts and requests at machine speed, the company says.
